roadmap.title: Story and collectibles
roadmap.description: Play the 17-chapter campaign on any difficulty while following the five collectible checklists. Chapter Select remains available for cleanup.

roadmap.title: Combat cleanup
roadmap.description: Use the listed campaign checkpoints to finish any combat techniques that did not unlock naturally.

roadmap.title: TacSim online completion
roadmap.description: After the campaign, complete an Escalation through Tier 3, finish an Operation, and earn enough XP for Clearance Level 3.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Chapter 1: Against the Odds} after surviving the helicopter crash.

guide.context: This mandatory story unlock is awarded at the end of the chapter, not immediately after the crash sequence.

steps.text: Complete the remaining objectives in @loc{Chapter 1: Against the Odds} until the chapter-ending transition awards the achievement.

achievements.description: Complete your training as a recruit in Malta.
achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Finish all Malta recruit training through @loc{Chapter 5: A New Home}.

guide.context: Several chapters contain training, so the achievement is not expected after the first training sequence.

steps.text: Continue the mandatory campaign through the end of @loc{Chapter 5: A New Home}; the achievement unlocks when the full Malta training arc is complete.

achievements.description: Complete your first assignment at the nightclub.
achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Complete the nightclub assignment in @loc{Chapter 6: A Night Out}.

guide.context: The nightclub assignment is mandatory story progress and can be completed on any difficulty.

steps.text: Finish every objective in @loc{Chapter 6: A Night Out} to receive the achievement at chapter completion.

achievements.description: Survive the explosion at the hotel in Slovakia.
achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Near the end of @loc{All the Time in the World} in Chapter 8, defeat the blond man and disarm the hotel bomb.

guide.context: This occurs at the end of the chess-championship section and is part of the required story route.

steps.text: Reach the cellar, defeat the blond man, and complete the bomb-disarming sequence; the achievement unlocks after Bond survives the explosion.

achievements.description: Jump out of a plane in Slovakia.
achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{All the Time in the World}, the eighth chapter, after Bond jumps from the plane in Slovakia.

guide.context: The plane jump and achievement are mandatory story events with no difficulty restriction.

steps.text: Continue beyond the hotel sequence and finish @loc{All the Time in the World}, the eighth chapter; its concluding plane escape awards the achievement.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Win the drone auction in @loc{The Past Never Dies}, the tenth chapter.

guide.context: The auction outcome is fixed by the campaign, so no optional bidding route or special preparation is required.

steps.text: Follow the mandatory auction objectives until Bond wins the drone auction and the achievement appears.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Aboard the tripwire-filled ship in @loc{The Past Never Dies}, the tenth chapter, find 009’s body.

guide.context: The discovery lies on the required story path after the tripwire-disarming section.

steps.text: Proceed through the ship, disarm the tripwire traps, and continue to the marked story discovery of 009’s body.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Survive the ambush and finish Chapter 10, @loc{The Past Never Dies}.

guide.context: The ambush is mandatory and has no achievement-specific difficulty requirement.

steps.text: Complete the final combat escape in @loc{The Past Never Dies}, the tenth chapter, and reach the ending transition alive.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Finish the sniper-targeted rooftop sequence in @loc{Chapter 11: Uninvited}.

guide.context: The assassination attempt is a mandatory mid-chapter sequence and cannot be bypassed.

steps.text: Cross the rooftop while the sniper targets Bond and complete the sequence until the achievement unlocks.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Murto} in the boss fight during @loc{Chapter 11: Uninvited}.

guide.context: The boss encounter is part of the required campaign route and can be cleared on any difficulty.

steps.text: Complete the Murto boss fight in @loc{Chapter 11: Uninvited}; the achievement unlocks when the assassin is defeated.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Chapter 11: Uninvited} by escaping in the bin lorry.

guide.context: The bin-lorry escape follows the chapter’s mandatory assassination and gala sequences.

steps.text: Continue the required escape objectives through the end of @loc{Chapter 11: Uninvited} until Bond leaves in the bin lorry.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Enter @loc{Nicholas Webb’s penthouse} during @loc{Chapter 12: Knightfall}.

guide.context: The penthouse infiltration is mandatory story progress and does not require a special route.

steps.text: Follow the infiltration objectives in @loc{Chapter 12: Knightfall} until Bond crosses into Nicholas Webb’s penthouse.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Chapter 12: Knightfall} by escaping in the helicopter.

guide.context: The helicopter escape is the required conclusion of the penthouse mission.

steps.text: Complete the remaining penthouse objectives and reach the helicopter escape at the end of @loc{Chapter 12: Knightfall}.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Murto} and save @npc{Theresa Lorca} in @loc{Chapter 14: Time to Die}.

guide.context: The rescue follows a mandatory boss encounter and can be completed on any difficulty.

steps.text: Win the Murto boss fight, then continue the required sequence until Theresa Lorca is safe and the achievement unlocks.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defeat @enemy{Damien Webb} and finish @loc{Chapter 14: Time to Die}.

guide.context: Damien Webb is the chapter’s required final opponent; no optional route controls the unlock.

steps.text: Complete the final confrontation with Damien Webb and reach the end of @loc{Chapter 14: Time to Die}.

achievements.description: Leave MI6 as a rogue agent.
achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Finish @loc{Chapter 15: Man of the Hour} and leave MI6 as a rogue agent.

guide.context: This status change is fixed mandatory story progression rather than a branching choice.

steps.text: Complete the Q-Lab and escape objectives through the end of @loc{Chapter 15: Man of the Hour}.

achievements.displayName: The writing is on the wall
achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Catch @npc{Isola} and finish @loc{Chapter 16: Wave of the Future}.

guide.context: The capture is the mandatory conclusion of the chapter and has no difficulty requirement.

steps.text: Complete the HYPERION pursuit and all remaining objectives until Isola is caught at the end of the chapter.

achievements.sortReason: Automatic campaign progression.
achievements.summary: Defend MI6 through the end of @loc{Chapter 17: For England}.

guide.context: This is the final mandatory campaign achievement; completing it also unlocks Operations in TacSim.

steps.text: Complete the defense of MI6 and finish every objective in @loc{Chapter 17: For England}.

achievements.sortReason: Follow during the campaign; clean up with Chapter Select.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{10 Postcards} across Chapters 1–17.

guide.context: Postcard pickups save immediately, so Chapter Select cleanup does not require reaching another checkpoint before leaving.

collectibles.name: Iceland Postcard
collectibles.location: @loc{Central Camp — Chapter 1, Checkpoint 06}, during either “Save the captives” or “Search containers B4 and G9”
collectibles.method: Enter container B2 and take the card from the desk beside the enemy.

collectibles.name: Malta Postcard
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 3, Checkpoint 01 “Basic training,” during “Follow Greenway”}
collectibles.method: After control returns, check the folding table with water bottles beside the training ground.

collectibles.name: Slovakia Postcard
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 8, Checkpoint 07 “Accessing Room 206,” during “Access room 206”}
collectibles.method: Obtain the Room 205 Keycard from the pacing maid or the earlier Staff Only room, enter Room 205, and check the bedside table.

collectibles.name: Mauritania Postcard
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 10, Checkpoint 03 “Black Market,” during “Obtain auction fee”}
collectibles.method: Near the red anchor, cut the fenced area’s padlock with the Laser Strap and take the card from the table.

collectibles.name: Kensington Postcard
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 11, Checkpoint 06 “Security Office,” during “Use the CCTV system”}
collectibles.method: Take the card from the table immediately left of the CCTV-room entrance.

collectibles.name: City of London Postcard
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 12, Checkpoint 02 “Executive 1st Floor,” during “Get to the stairs”}
collectibles.method: After Greenway’s boost, traverse the balcony ledge into the window and check the counter on the left.

collectibles.name: Vietnam Postcard
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 14, Checkpoint 05 “The three targets,” during “Approach Ellis White”}
collectibles.method: Enter the Ocean View Bar by the railing or with a pickpocketed Party Flyer, then check a table on the right.

collectibles.name: Q-Lab Postcard
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 15, Checkpoint 04 “The betrayal,” during “Steal field equipment”}
collectibles.method: Climb the Q-01 Gym lockers, cross to the ledge, enter the hallway, and check the table at its end.

collectibles.name: Antarctica Postcard
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 16, Checkpoint 16 “Safety off,” during “Reach HYPERION”}
collectibles.method: Defeat the android, use the Override Key on the objective door, cross the metal beam, and check the trolley by the window.

collectibles.name: MI6 Postcard
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 17, Checkpoint 06 “Backstairs,” during “Pick up the earpiece / Locate Moneypenny”}
collectibles.method: After collecting the earpiece, squeeze past the shelves and look on the floor directly beyond them.

achievements.sortReason: Follow during the campaign; clean up with Chapter Select.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{23 Intel files} to complete the MI6 file collection.

guide.context: An Intel pickup’s world-object label can differ from its character or topic label in the collectible menu; each checklist name includes both when they differ.

collectibles.name: Workshop Notice (Selina Tan)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 4, Checkpoint 04 “Q-Lab,” during “Meet and greet”}
collectibles.method: In the room containing Q and Selina Tan, check the back-right cupboard near two scientists.

collectibles.name: Recruit Stats (00 Recruits)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 4, Checkpoint 04 “Q-Lab,” after speaking to Q and completing the Q-Watch tutorial}
collectibles.method: Interact with the screen behind Q’s original position beside the green Range Rover test chamber.

collectibles.name: Family Photo (Lennox Monroe)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 5, Checkpoint 01 “Home,” during “Make yourself at home”}
collectibles.method: Check the cupboard in the living room’s right corner.

collectibles.name: Dress Box (Cressida Bright)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 5, Checkpoint 01 “Home,” during “See what Cressida wants”}
collectibles.method: Inspect the gift box on Cressida’s bed.

collectibles.name: Arrowhead Report (Arrowhead)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 7, Checkpoint 07 “Operations,” during “Go to Moneypenny’s pod”}
collectibles.method: Leave the elevator and walk away from the objective to the desk at the far end of the floor.

collectibles.name: 009 Profile (009)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 7, Checkpoint 08 “Master Manipulator,” during “Get briefing from Moneypenny”}
collectibles.method: Take the file from Moneypenny’s desk.

collectibles.name: Facial Composite (Niko and Tero Murto)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 9, Checkpoint 05 “Talk to Moneypenny”}
collectibles.method: After riding to Operations, walk behind the elevator and check the back-left cabinet.

collectibles.name: Delivery Box (Bawma)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 10, Checkpoint 03 “Black Market,” during “Obtain auction fee”}
collectibles.method: Check the market stall immediately left of the shooting range in the market’s back-left area.

collectibles.name: Photo of Greenway (John Greenway)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 10, Checkpoint 08 “Examine the crime scene”}
collectibles.method: Enter the last room of the crime scene and check the cupboard on the left.

collectibles.name: Bond Family Photo (James Bond)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 11, Checkpoint 02 “Back home,” during “Go to Bond’s room”}
collectibles.method: Check the nightstand to the right of Bond’s bed.

collectibles.name: Webb Industries Press Pack (Webb Industries)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 11, Checkpoint 05 “Get upstairs,” during “Find the assassin”}
collectibles.method: Distract the press-room guard with the rear-right fuse box, bluff the woman, and take the file beside the guard.

collectibles.name: Security Notice (Stephen Bright)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 11, Checkpoint 06 “Security Office,” during “Get into the CCTV room”}
collectibles.method: Enter the front-right door of the security area and check the table.

collectibles.name: Wooden Spoon (Roger Finch)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 12, Checkpoint 02 “Executive 1st Floor,” during “Get to the stairs”}
collectibles.method: Kick open the left bathroom stall for the office key, enter R. Finch’s office, and check the stand on the right.

collectibles.name: Employment Contract (Isola Vale)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 12, Checkpoint 02 “Executive 1st Floor,” during “Bypass the sensors”}
collectibles.method: Use the shared vent to reach the second office and check the left side of its desk.

collectibles.name: Psych Profile (Damien Webb)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 12, Checkpoint 03 “The Penthouse,” during “Locate and open the safe”}
collectibles.method: Check the shelf in the penthouse’s back-right corner.

collectibles.name: Driving Gloves (Q)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 13, Checkpoint 04 “In the zone,” during “Collect field equipment”}
collectibles.method: After meeting Q, inspect the desk on the right.

collectibles.name: Keynote Presentation (Theresa Lorca)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 14, Checkpoint 05 “The three targets,” during “Reach Theresa Lorca”}
collectibles.method: After the conversation cutscene, pick up the file from the ground in front of the pool.

collectibles.name: Caliban Profile (Caliban)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 14, Checkpoint 07 “Suit up,” during “Join the party”}
collectibles.method: Leave the bedroom through the left hallway and check the counter at the living-room entrance.

collectibles.name: Gun Case (Riptide)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 14, Checkpoint 15 “Tracking Damien,” during “Pursue Damien”}
collectibles.method: After Bond is freed from the handcuffs, check the wooden cable spool on the right.

collectibles.name: Q’s Photo (Rhys Beckett)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 15, Checkpoint 04 “The betrayal,” during “Steal field equipment”}
collectibles.method: Trigger the fire extinguisher above the Q-03 Stress Testing door scanner, then open the cabinet inside with code 4397.

collectibles.name: M Profile (M)
collectibles.location: @loc{Operations Department — Chapter 16, Checkpoint 12}, during the “Upgrade ID bracelet” objective inside the Security Office
collectibles.method: Check the Security Office desk.

collectibles.name: Webb’s Manuscript (Sir Nicholas Webb)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 16, Checkpoint 12 “Operations Department,” during “Access the Command Centre”}
collectibles.method: Take the manuscript from the chair on the rock beside the cat statue.

collectibles.name: Wallet (Eve Moneypenny)
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 17, Checkpoint 10 “Utility tunnels I,” during “Get to THEIA”}
collectibles.method: Shut down the fan from the wall panel, pass through it, and take the wallet from the ledge before descending the ladder.

achievements.sortReason: Follow during the campaign; clean up with Chapter Select.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{14 Mementos} across Chapters 1–17.

guide.context: The Q-Watch highlights nearby collectible objects in yellow after it unlocks in Chapter 4, which helps confirm small props before pickup.

collectibles.name: Satellite Part
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 1, Checkpoint 06 “Central Camp,” during “Free the captives in container G9”}
collectibles.method: The part is directly ahead upon entering objective container G9.

collectibles.name: Cocktail Napkin
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 6, Checkpoint 05 “Get upstairs,” during “Get to the upstairs lounge”}
collectibles.method: Use the Staff Only route behind the bar and check the counter.

collectibles.name: Pillow Mint
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 8, Checkpoint 03 “The game is on,” during “Search the hotel”}
collectibles.method: Distract or avoid the pickpocketable staffer, enter the left-side Staff Only room, and inspect the cabinet beside the chair blocking a door.

collectibles.name: Championship Badge
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 8, Checkpoint 03 “The game is on,” during “Search the hotel”}
collectibles.method: Squeeze through the boxes left of the chess-stage hall, turn left backstage, and check the large black crate.

collectibles.name: Pirate Grillz
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 10, Checkpoint 03 “Black Market,” after obtaining the required $100,000 auction fee}
collectibles.method: Buy the item from the white-shirted merchant under the red umbrella near the pawn shop.

collectibles.name: Crocodile Tooth
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 10, Checkpoint 09 “Leaving Aleph,” during “Enter Land Rover”}
collectibles.method: Check the crate behind and to the right of the Land Rover.

collectibles.name: Anniversary Pin
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 11, Checkpoint 05 “Get upstairs,” during “Find the assassin”}
collectibles.method: Distract the guard beside the press room, enter the Cloakroom, squeeze through the gap, and check the shelf.

collectibles.name: Tero Murto Locket
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 11, Checkpoint 07 “Basement,” after the Murto fight}
collectibles.method: Collect the Restoration Room Keycard from Room 4, unlock Room 3 across the corridor, and check its right-hand table.

collectibles.name: Office Toy
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 12, Checkpoint 02 “Executive 1st Floor,” during “Bypass the sensors”}
collectibles.method: Move the furniture with Greenway, enter the vent, take its first left exit, and check the office’s upper-right counter.

collectibles.name: Diving Watch
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 14, Checkpoint 07 “Suit up,” during “Join the party”}
collectibles.method: After the bow-tie quick-time event, turn around and check the nightstand to the bed’s right.

collectibles.name: Niko Murto Locket
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 15, Checkpoint 02 “Stand down,” during “Talk to Moneypenny”}
collectibles.method: Descend the short stairs slightly left of the start and check the desk near Basil.

collectibles.name: Snow Globe
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 16, Checkpoint 04 “The gate house,” during “Access the cable car”}
collectibles.method: Inspect the central reception desk.

collectibles.name: Robot Keychain
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 16, Checkpoint 19 “Silo entrance,” during “Reach HYPERION”}
collectibles.method: After the long silo descent, zipline down, crawl through the air vent, and check the podium behind Bond after dropping into the office.

collectibles.name: Dashboard Toy
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 17, Checkpoint 14 “Q Lab showdown,” during “Find Valhalla keys”}
collectibles.method: Enter Q-07 Wearables and inspect the small coffee table.

achievements.sortReason: Follow during the campaign; clean up with Chapter Select.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{36 Playing Cards} across Chapters 1–17.

guide.context: Several later cards require the Laser Strap. Equip it in Chapter 9’s Q-Lab and continue forward, because starting directly from Chapter Select can replace the required gadget loadout.

collectibles.name: 7 of Acorns
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 1, Checkpoint 04 “Deployment Camp,” during “Move the BT-65”}
collectibles.method: After the vehicle crash scene, check the shelving to the right of the remote.

collectibles.name: Under of Acorns
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 5, Checkpoint 02 “Advanced Training,” during “Enter the training grounds”}
collectibles.method: Open the first hackable gate, return to the starting platform, climb its stairs, and check the forward ledge.

collectibles.name: 7 of Roses
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 5, Checkpoint 10 “Search the compound,” during “Steal the flag”}
collectibles.method: Enter the large pier-side double doors and check the pallets in the room containing three enemies.

collectibles.name: Ober of Bells
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 6, Checkpoint 05 “Get upstairs,” during “Get to the upstairs lounge”}

collectibles.name: Ace of Acorns
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 8, Checkpoint 02 “In Position,” during “Investigate the blond man”}
collectibles.method: After parking, climb the stairs and descend the next stairs on the left to the railing.

collectibles.name: Ober of Shields
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 8, Checkpoint 03 “The game is on,” during “Search the hotel”}
collectibles.method: Enter the dining room off the chess hall and check the front-left table.

collectibles.name: 6 of Roses
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 8, Checkpoint 03 “The game is on,” during “Search the hotel”}
collectibles.method: Reach the restricted Manager’s Office behind reception and open the under-desk safe with code 1952.

collectibles.name: 6 of Acorns
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 8, Checkpoint 08 “Delivery Area,” during “Pursue the blond man”}
collectibles.method: Follow the blue cable through the service corridor, exit, turn left onto the terrace, and check the table.

collectibles.name: 7 of Bells
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 8, Checkpoint 10 “The vanishing,” during “Pursue the blond man”}
collectibles.method: After solving the dining-room sequence Lion > Snake > Goat, vault the first cellar table, turn left through the bars, and check the crate.

collectibles.name: 6 of Bells
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 10, Checkpoint 02 “Arriving at Aleph,” during “Follow Greenway”}
collectibles.method: After leaving the car and entering the shipwreck market, take the left path into the bathroom.

collectibles.name: 9 of Acorns
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 10, Checkpoint 03 “Black Market,” during “Obtain auction fee”}
collectibles.method: Near two eavesdroppable guards, use the equipped Laser Strap to break the fish tank containing the card.

collectibles.name: Ober of Acorns
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 10, Checkpoint 03 “Black Market,” during “Obtain auction fee”}
collectibles.method: Beyond the fenced postcard room, find the truck and laser open the wall cabinet behind it.

collectibles.name: Ace of Roses
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 10, Checkpoint 03 “Black Market,” during “Obtain auction fee”}
collectibles.method: Climb to the Fight Club’s upper floor, leave through the doorway beside the bar’s left end, and inspect the box in the small rooftop room.

collectibles.name: Banner of Shields
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 10, Checkpoint 07 “Find 009,” during “Find 009”}
collectibles.method: On the tripwire ship, take the right staircase, then turn around and search the front of the upper deck.

collectibles.name: 6 of Shields
collectibles.location: @loc{Find a way inside the shipwreck — Chapter 10, Checkpoint 10}, during “Follow the clues”
collectibles.method: After climbing the chain and crossing the zipline, check the barrel before the blue pipe used for the drawbridge.

collectibles.name: 8 of Acorns
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 11, Checkpoint 04 “Gala Entrance,” during “Enter the Webb gala”}
collectibles.method: Check the stone bench in the first hall’s back-right corner, right of reception.

collectibles.name: Ober of Roses
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 11, Checkpoint 05 “Get upstairs,” during “Find the assassin”}
collectibles.method: Kick through the door beside the Cloakroom route, climb upstairs, clear the enemies, and inspect the white box in the room’s center.

collectibles.name: King of Shields
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 11, Checkpoint 09 “Storage room,” during “Escape with Isola / Check the doors”}
collectibles.method: After leaving the chair, turn around and check the table.

collectibles.name: 8 of Roses
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 11, Checkpoint 09 “Storage room,” during “Reach the adjacent balcony”}
collectibles.method: Cross the lighting rig, turn right on the next balcony, and inspect the table.

collectibles.name: 9 of Shields

collectibles.name: Banner of Roses

collectibles.method: Shimmy between the waterfalls and hack the sensor from inside; remain there until Greenway opens the door, then inspect the billiard table.

collectibles.name: 7 of Shields
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 12, Checkpoint 02 “Executive 1st Floor,” during “Get to the Penthouse”}
collectibles.method: On Level 3, enter Bohr, hack the Einstein-office door, and check Einstein’s desk.

collectibles.name: King of Acorns
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 12, Checkpoint 02 “Executive 1st Floor,” during “Get to the Penthouse”}
collectibles.method: After obtaining the Security Access Key, open the side balcony doors near Einstein’s office and check the table.

collectibles.name: Under of Shields
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 12, Checkpoint 09 “Cargo floor,” during “Locate the helicopter”}
collectibles.method: At the flight-deck stairs, descend instead of climbing and check the crate.

collectibles.name: Banner of Acorns

collectibles.method: In Tranquility Cave, eavesdrop on the caller, use the Dart Phone to enable pickpocketing his Storage Key, unlock the nearby room, and check the left shelf.

collectibles.method: Follow signs to Lotus Bar and check the counter at the rear.

collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 16, Checkpoint 03 “The gantries,” during “Reach the gate house”}

achievements.sortReason: Follow during the campaign; clean up with Chapter Select.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{92 collectibles}: 36 Playing Cards, 23 Intel files, 14 Mementos, 10 Postcards, and 9 Legacy Items.

guide.context: The collectible menu tracks totals by type rather than chapter, and every pickup saves immediately for Chapter Select cleanup.

steps.text: Complete the @item{10-Postcard} checklist for The World Is Not Enough.
Complete the @item{23-Intel} checklist for For Your Eyes Only.
Complete the @item{14-Memento} checklist for Recovered Assets.
Complete the @item{36-Playing-Card} checklist for Casino Royale.
Complete the @item{9-Legacy-Item} checklist for A Legacy of Spycraft.

achievements.description: Tackle an enemy over a ledge
achievements.sortReason: Use the recommended checkpoint during post-story cleanup.
achievements.summary: Hold an enemy in a continuous shove and tackle that enemy over a ledge so the landing knocks the enemy out.

guide.context: Chapter Select makes the early Chapter 5 setup repeatable, and the ladder-top ledge provides enough drop for the landing knockout.

steps.text: Load @loc{Checkpoint 10: Search the Compound} from @loc{A New Home}, the fifth chapter, and follow the @mechanic{Steal the flag} objective to an enemy near the top of a ladder.
Hold the grab input to keep the backward-push animation active, steer the enemy over the ladder ledge, and fall together until the impact knocks the enemy out.

achievements.description: Disarm an enemy by shooting a weapon from their hand
achievements.sortReason: Use the recommended checkpoint during post-story cleanup.
achievements.summary: Shoot an aiming enemy’s weapon hand so the enemy drops the weapon.

guide.context: Chapter 3’s mandatory training teaches the disarm and normally awards the achievement without separate cleanup.

steps.text: Play @loc{Chapter 3: The Needle’s Eye} until the weapon-disarm training begins.
Wait for the armed enemy to aim at Bond, then shoot the enemy’s weapon hand until the weapon is knocked free.

achievements.description: Make an enemy taser another enemy
achievements.sortReason: Use the recommended checkpoint during post-story cleanup.
achievements.summary: Move a grabbed enemy into a taser enemy’s blue aiming line and let the taser shot hit the grabbed enemy.

guide.context: Taser carriers in the laundry wear weapon holsters and bulletproof vests; keeping combat active for roughly 30 seconds prompts them to begin aiming.

steps.text: Load @loc{Checkpoint 05: The laundry} from @loc{All the Time in the World}, the eighth chapter, at the @mechanic{Get through the laundry} objective.
Keep one taser-equipped enemy and one other enemy alive, then wait for the taser’s bright blue aiming line.
Hold grab for the extended drag animation, push the second enemy directly into the blue line, and keep the enemy there until the taser shot connects.
steps.note: Tapping grab is unreliable because the shorter animation does not provide enough control.

achievements.description: Shoot at an enemy while he's throwing a grenade
achievements.sortReason: Use the recommended checkpoint during post-story cleanup.
achievements.summary: Shoot a grenade-throwing enemy while the grenade is still in the enemy’s hand, forcing the grenade to drop.

guide.context: Aiming slow motion or the Q-Watch slowdown widens the short window during the throwing animation.

steps.text: Load @loc{Checkpoint 11: Ambush} from @loc{The Past Never Dies}, the tenth chapter, and hide behind cover near the enemies.
Wait until an enemy draws a grenade and begins the arm swing, then shoot the thrower before the grenade leaves the hand.
If needed, use @loc{Webb Exhibition — Chapter 11: Uninvited, Checkpoint 11} for another attempt.

achievements.description: Knock out an enemy by shooting him in the legs
achievements.sortReason: Use the recommended checkpoint during post-story cleanup.
achievements.summary: Knock out one enemy with repeated leg shots, ensuring the final disabling bullet also hits a leg.

guide.context: Credit is determined by the final disabling hit, so one early leg shot followed by a torso or head finish does not qualify.

steps.text: Choose a regular enemy with enough health to survive the first leg shot.
Fire only into that enemy’s legs until the final leg bullet knocks the enemy out and awards the achievement.

achievements.description: Push an enemy into a fire extinguisher
achievements.sortReason: Use the recommended checkpoint during post-story cleanup.
achievements.summary: Hold an enemy in a shove and push that enemy into a wall-mounted fire extinguisher.

guide.context: The laundry checkpoint places a usable extinguisher in the back-left corner from the entrance, allowing a quick Chapter Select retry.

steps.text: Load @loc{Checkpoint 05: The laundry} from @loc{All the Time in the World}, the eighth chapter, at the @mechanic{Get through the laundry} objective.
Draw an enemy to the wall-mounted extinguisher in the back-left corner from the entry point.
Hold the grab input and steer the enemy backward into the extinguisher until the collision awards the achievement.

achievements.description: Hack a grenade before it explodes
achievements.sortReason: Use the recommended checkpoint during post-story cleanup.
achievements.summary: Use the Q-Watch to hack and deactivate an enemy grenade after it lands but before it explodes.

guide.context: The Ambush checkpoint starts beside grenade-equipped enemies and provides nearby cover for waiting safely through repeated throws.

steps.text: Load @loc{Checkpoint 11: Ambush} from @loc{The Past Never Dies}, the tenth chapter, take cover, and wait for an enemy grenade to land.
Aim the Q-Watch at the live grenade and press the displayed hack input before the fuse expires; the grenade must deactivate without exploding.
Use @loc{Webb Exhibition — Chapter 11: Uninvited, Checkpoint 11} as an alternate grenade encounter.

achievements.description: Disarm an enemy with a laser
achievements.sortReason: Use the recommended checkpoint during post-story cleanup.
achievements.summary: Fire the equipped Laser Strap at an aiming enemy’s weapon to disarm that enemy.

guide.context: The Laser Strap unlocks in Chapter 9 and consumes electric charges replenished by blue batteries; it also works against taser-equipped enemies.

steps.text: Finish the Laser Strap unlock in @loc{Chapter 9: Out of the Ashes}, then equip @item{Laser Strap} for the Q-Watch in Q-Lab before starting a mission.
Let an armed enemy detect Bond and raise a firearm or taser into an aiming stance.
Hold the Q-Watch input and fire the Laser Strap at the raised weapon until the enemy drops it.

achievements.description: Use a gadget to escape a confrontation
achievements.sortReason: Use the recommended checkpoint during post-story cleanup.
achievements.summary: Use a Q-Watch distraction during a restricted-area confrontation to break contact and escape.

guide.context: Q-Watch distraction gadgets become available in Chapter 4, and the required confrontation is the civilian dialogue state that offers bluff or comply.

steps.text: Enter a restricted area containing civilians and deliberately let a civilian confront Bond.
Remain in the confrontation until the dialogue presents the @mechanic{Bluff} and @mechanic{Comply} responses.
During that dialogue, hold the Q-Watch input, activate a distraction gadget on the confronting civilian, and leave while that civilian is distracted.

achievements.sortReason: Complete in the final online TacSim phase.
achievements.summary: After finishing the campaign, complete any online @mechanic{Operation} from the Tactical Simulations menu.

guide.context: Operations replay campaign combat or stealth encounters with modified objectives and remain locked until the main story is complete.

steps.text: From the title screen, select @mechanic{Tactical Simulations} and open the Operations list.
Select an Operation and satisfy its modified objectives through the completion screen.
steps.note: The first Operation is recommended and takes about three minutes.

achievements.sortReason: Complete in the final online TacSim phase.
achievements.summary: After Chapter 6, complete any online @mechanic{Escalation} from the Tactical Simulations menu.

guide.context: The first Escalation is a short combat tutorial and takes roughly one minute, making it the quickest initial completion.

steps.text: Finish @loc{Chapter 6: A Night Out} to unlock Escalations.
From the title screen, select @mechanic{Tactical Simulations}, choose an Escalation, and clear its current tier through the completion screen.

achievements.sortReason: Complete in the final online TacSim phase.
achievements.summary: After completing @loc{Chapter 6: A Night Out}, earn enough online TacSim XP from Escalations, Operations, and Challenges to reach @mechanic{Clearance Level 3}.

guide.context: Game version 1.1.0 fixed the previous Level 3 achievement trigger. Clearance XP also unlocks TacSim weapons and gadgets.

steps.text: After Chapter 6 unlocks TacSim, complete an Escalation through Tier 3; finish the campaign to unlock Operations, then complete one Operation for its XP.
Return to the TacSim hub and check the displayed Clearance Level.
If the level is below 3, open the in-mission Challenges menu and complete quick XP tasks until Clearance Level 3 appears.
steps.note: Tier 2, “The Test,” in Advanced Tactical Training includes quick challenges for pushing enemies over cliffs.

achievements.description: Beat tier 3 of an Escalation in TacSim
achievements.sortReason: Complete in the final online TacSim phase.
achievements.summary: After completing @loc{Chapter 6: A Night Out}, finish all three tiers of one online @mechanic{TacSim Escalation}.

guide.context: The first Escalation is designed as a short combat tutorial with tiers of roughly one minute each.

steps.text: From the title screen, select @mechanic{Tactical Simulations} and choose the first Escalation.
Finish Tier 1, Tier 2, and Tier 3 in sequence by satisfying every displayed objective.
If an objective is unfamiliar, open the in-mission menu and select that objective to view its control tutorial.

achievements.sortReason: Follow during the campaign; clean up with Chapter Select.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{9 Legacy Items} across Chapters 1–16.

guide.context: Install game version 1.1.0 or later before final cleanup; that update corrected the Legacy Item achievement trigger.

collectibles.name: Cruciform Key
collectibles.location: @loc{Central Camp — Chapter 1, Checkpoint 06}, during either “Save the captives” or “Search containers B4 and G9”
collectibles.method: After dropping into the camp, enter container F8 and check the shelf.

collectibles.name: Dagger Shoes
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 7, Checkpoint 03 “Field Equipment,” during “Go to gadget testing”}
collectibles.method: After speaking with Q in Q-07 Wearables, inspect the shoes on the table.

collectibles.name: Chess Biography
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 8, Checkpoint 03 “The game is on,” during “Search the hotel”}
collectibles.method: Descend the left stairs, turn right at the bottom, and check the small table in the far seating area near two men discussing an Aston Martin.

collectibles.name: ATAC Device
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 10, Checkpoint 03 “Black Market,” during the Crypto Wallet route}
collectibles.method: Eavesdrop near the shooting range, track “The crypto wallet,” defeat the rooftop brute, then descend below the signal tower and cross the metal beam to the crate.

collectibles.name: Concert Poster
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 11, Checkpoint 05 “Get upstairs,” during “Find the assassin”}
collectibles.method: After entering the gala with the invitation, visit the back-left Café and check its back-right table.

collectibles.name: Blades Club Badge
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 12, Checkpoint 03 “The Penthouse,” during “Locate and open the safe”}
collectibles.method: Turn right upon entering the penthouse and inspect the bar table.

collectibles.name: Tarot Deck
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 14, Checkpoint 05 “The three targets,” during “Reach Ramon Hernandez”}
collectibles.method: After speaking to Ramon, enter the bedroom and check the nightstand left of the bed.

collectibles.name: Trilby Hat
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 15, Checkpoint 04 “The betrayal,” during “Steal field equipment”}
collectibles.method: In Q-Lab’s Q-07 Wearables area near the elevator, inspect the changing rooms.

collectibles.name: Jaws Design Specs
collectibles.location: @loc{Chapter 16, Checkpoint 08 “Robotics Department,” during “Locate the Command Centre”}
collectibles.method: After the elevator enters the Robotics testing hall, go to the far-left corner and check the crate.
